headline: Medios Shares Jump 8% Following New Share Buyback Program Announcement
summary: Medios shares jumped 8% after the company announced the launch of a new share buyback program.
why: Medios is a specialty pharmaceutical distributor, and share buyback programs are commonly used to return excess capital to shareholders and signal management confidence.

impacts.name: Medios
impacts.why: The company announced a new share buyback program.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement of a new share buyback program signaled strong capital allocation and bolstered investor demand.
